errors.what: One solid estradiol feedback path is labeled “negative feedback” and “positive at mid-cycle: LH surge.”
errors.why_wrong: The annotation states the exception correctly, but the drawing does not distinguish the usual negative feedback from the mid-cycle positive switch. A student could read them as simultaneous effects.

errors.what: The hormone and feedback labels are small relative to the image.
errors.why_wrong: They remain readable at full size, but are difficult to scan at this displayed size.

verdict: Physiologically sound and clear enough for review. Separate visual states for usual feedback and the mid-cycle switch would make the key exception easier to learn.
